messages:
talia: Final reminder: privacy micro-training + SOC2 evidence confirmations are due this Friday. Managers: please upload screenshots or a one-line CSV per direct report. Link: https://go.redwood/submit-evidence :hourglass_flowing_sand:

talia: If you're delegating signing because of oncall/travel, use the "delegate" field in the form and include the delegate's name.

marcus: Quick Q  contractors included? We have two contractors on my team.

talia: Yes include contractors who appear in Okta/headcount. If someone shouldn't be counted, mark "exclude" with a short justification.

elin: I have one engineer on parental leave  should I mark OOO and expected completion date?

talia: Yes  mark OOO and put expected completion date in the form. That counts as an exception note.

sanjay: Uploaded CSV for infra + service accounts. Marked two entries as "exception requested" with ETA next Wed.

compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled  auto-DM to managers on 2026-07-02T09:00Z and follow-up on 2026-07-03T16:00Z.

marcus: Thanks  I'll batch my team's attestations tomorrow morning.

talia: Appreciate it  audit will sample a subset after the window closes. Ping me if you need a short exception approved.
